research_question: Can the existence of at least one within-B analytic exact-DP fallback be certified from local residual scalars, without enumerating exact-DP states, and what universal obligation remains after such a certificate?

notation.SP_x: sum of clause lengths over +x parents
notation.SN_x: sum of clause lengths over -x parents

implemented_analytic_bound_identity.source: algebraic expansion of the frozen AB formulas UB_C and UB_L

hypotheses: F is a canonical W-policy residual
every remaining variable occurs in both polarities because otherwise the frozen PURE door would be live
every canonical clause has width at most V
preregistered_local_lemma.claim: There exists a variable x with UB_S(x) <= G(S,V), where G(S,V)=S+(2V-1)*S^2/(4*V^2).
paper_proof_skeleton: Choose x of minimum occurrence degree d_x. Since sum_x d_x=L, d_x<=L/V<=S/V.
Because every parent clause has width <=V, SP_x<=p_x*V and SN_x<=q_x*V.
Using the exact UB identity and dropping negative terms except the net -p_x*q_x gives UB_S(x)<=S+(2V-1)*p_x*q_x.

safe_envelope.consequence: at least one analytic pivot has UB_S<=B and therefore its exact canonical DP result has scalar size <=B, subject to the already-audited soundness of UB_S
does_not_claim: that every residual satisfies the safe envelope
that W-policy restarts preserve the safe envelope
that state-size boundedness alone proves polynomial runtime
that Galil's Davis-Putnam lower bound is bypassed universally

checks: G(S,V)<=B for every recorded AB residual event
chosen_UB_S<=G(S,V) for every recorded AB residual event
report maximum G/B and minimum B-G safety slack
retain the already-sealed Phi4/Phi3 counterexamples unchanged

universal_obligation_after_success: Prove or falsify that every root-reachable W residual under the hybrid scheduler remains inside G(S,V)<=B before controlled DP fallback. The invariant S<=B alone is not asserted to imply this stronger safe envelope.
